_comment: Single source of truth for task-type SEMANTICS. The tag NAME still lives in plan.md task names ([Migrate] X); this file holds what the tag MEANS (routing + gate exemptions). Code reads this via track_state.task_profiles, not hardcoded Python sets. Adding a task type = one row here (plus, if it needs special executor behavior, an agent-prose branch — see runtime/contracts/plan-format-contract.md).

_fields.route: which dispatch category drives _classify_task: manual | explore | executor
_fields.tdd_exempt: true => task is exempt from the TDD (red/green/refactor) gate
_fields.coverage_exempt: true => task is exempt from the coverage (F2/F3) gate. Explore is tdd_exempt but NOT coverage_exempt: it produces no code, yet must not skip coverage accounting on adjacent changes.
